property_summary: After a successful call to withdrawAll by the owner, any non-zero contract balance before the call must be zero after the call; the bug leaves the full balance untouched, transferring only 1 wei instead of the entire balance, so the post-call balance is non-zero when the pre-call balance was >0.
change_summary: Change the transfer amount to a fixed value of 1 wei instead of the entire balance.
